name: AdminFly – Fast Navigator for WooCommerce
author: Pranav MT

sections.description:
AdminFly is a streamlined admin-bar navigator built for speed and simplicity. It provides a compact, hierarchical menu placed in the WordPress admin bar so you can reach common WooCommerce and WordPress management screens instantly.

Key Features:

  • ⚡️ Fast access: One-click shortcuts to frequently used admin pages
  • 🛒 WooCommerce-first: Quick links for Products, Orders, Customers, Analytics, and Settings
  • 🔎 Edit-by-ID: Prompt-to-open edit screens for Product, Order, Post, Page, and User by ID
  • ⚙️ Customizable branches: Enable or disable sections (WooCommerce, Products, Orders, Plugins, Themes, Posts, Pages, Users)
  • 🧭 Minimal UI: Lightweight, non-intrusive admin-bar integration
  • 🔐 Secure: Uses WordPress capability checks and nonces for settings

Usage

  1. Visit Tools → AdminFly to open settings
  2. Toggle the menu branches you want and click Save
  3. Click the AdminFly icon in the admin bar to reveal quick links
  4. Use Edit-by-ID items to open specific items in a new tab

Support

Open an issue or contact the author for support and feature requests.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the quickmenu-for-woocommerce folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin via the WordPress Plugins screen
  3. Go to Tools → AdminFly to choose which sections to display
  4. AdminFly appears in the admin bar immediately after activation
sections.faq:
Does it work without WooCommerce?

Yes — AdminFly gracefully hides WooCommerce-specific links when WooCommerce is not active.

Can I customize which links show?

Yes — open Tools → AdminFly and enable/disable branches. Preferences are saved in the WordPress options table.

Is it resource intensive?

No — AdminFly is intentionally small and optimized for performance.
